settings.html:
A full lower limb assessment of how you stand, walk and load — the starting point for every treatment plan here. Treats heel pain, knee pain and shin splints.

Call to book About Biomechanics

Custom orthotics are prescribed here and manufactured at our Kirrawee head office. Prescribed against your assessment. Commonly used for flat feet and plantar fasciitis.

Call to book About Custom Orthotics

Acoustic waves using kinetic energy to repair tissue and reduce chronic inflammation. Used for persistent heel pain and Achilles pain.

Call to book About Shockwave Therapy

Fine needles inserted into trigger points to break down restrictive tissue.

Call to book About Dry Needling

Assessment and treatment for running injuries, shin splints and return to sport.

Call to book About Sports Podiatry

settings.editor: All ten treatments are available at Forster/Tuncurry.
How we work
Every appointment here starts with the Najjarine Biomechanical Assessment, so treatment is prescribed against a diagnosis rather than a symptom.

image.alt: Dr Abbie Najjarine assessing a patient’s gait on a treadmill

settings.editor: 01
A full biomechanical examination of how you stand, walk and load — not just the painful area.
02
We identify the structural or muscular irregularity causing the pain, and explain what we found.
03
A treatment regime prescribed against that diagnosis, drawing on all ten treatments.

settings.editor: Questions
No. Podiatry is a primary contact profession in Australia, so you can book directly. If you are on a Medicare care plan your GP will refer you, and we can bill that.
Orthotics are prescribed here from your assessment and manufactured at our Kirrawee head office. Usually ready within 7 to 10 days.
Yes. Children’s podiatry is available here, including assessment for in-toeing, flat feet and growing pains. Children are seen at all of our clinics.
Allow about 45 minutes. That covers the biomechanical assessment, the diagnosis and an explanation of the treatment plan before anything is prescribed.
Yes. Forster/Tuncurry has HICAPS, so private health rebates come off at reception. Medicare care plans and NDIS plans are accepted.
